<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Add opt-in `synchronize_iterations_across_dp` to align profiler delay/duration across DP ranks sharing target-model forwards, including idle ranks doing dummy work.

## Claims

- Reuse existing DP coordination; no profiling-only collective. The fixed readiness row adds one int32 per DP rank, even when disabled.
- Preserve default rank-local behavior, DP=1, unsupported-runner fallback, and #57875's session-specific bounds.
- Support MRV1/MRV2, bounded stop, and restart. Skipped coordination and all-rank idle polls do not advance the clock.

## Validation

Local CPU checks: **109 passed, 76 skipped** (profiler); **32 passed, 10 skipped** (DP coordination). `pre-commit` and `git diff --check` passed.

```sh
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_profiler.py -q
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_ubatch_slicing.py -q
```

Local runs used the existing `skip_global_cleanup` marker via an uncommitted plugin for a platform cleanup issue; skipped accelerator tests are not passes.

An earlier CUDA run had **289 passed, 6 CPU-worker initialization failures**. All six cases remain; fresh-interpreter isolation awaits CUDA confirmation. Current-head multi-GPU/Nsight validation (idle ranks, graph replay, async/speculative execution, stop/restart) and overhead measurements remain pending. Hosted CI is not green: authorization is required, and an earlier Intel CI failure remains undiagnosed.

## Details

Add `"synchronize_iterations_across_dp":true` to `--profiler-config`. Arm every participating rank with identical settings before traffic; use `max_iterations` for aligned automatic stop. Explicit stop remains immediate locally. Independent replicas without a shared forward cadence should leave this disabled.

Worker callbacks advance the existing profiler at agreed runner boundaries. MRV1 compatibility retains the same option for existing deployments. Usage and edge cases are documented in the profiling guide.

@@ -278,6 +278,46 @@ vllm bench serve \
 
 With `--profile`, vLLM will capture a profile for each run of `vllm bench serve`. Once the server is killed, the profiles will all be saved.
 
+To align iteration-bounded captures across ranks that share a data-parallel
+model-forward cadence, enable synchronized profiler iterations on every rank:
+
+```bash
+vllm serve mistralai/Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1 \
+    --data-parallel-size 2 \
+    --enable-expert-parallel \
+    --profiler-config '{"profiler":"cuda","delay_iterations":100,"max_iterations":20,"synchronize_iterations_across_dp":true}'
+```
+
+Arm profiling on every participating rank before sending traffic. The profiler
+starts after all ranks report ready through vLLM's existing DP coordination.
+`delay_iterations` and `max_iterations` then count those shared execution
+boundaries, including dummy model forwards on locally idle ranks. Per-session
+`delay_iterations` and `max_iterations` passed to `/start_profile` apply the same
+way and are validated when the session is armed. The existing
+coordination reserves one readiness field, including when the option is disabled,
+so the collective shape does not depend on local profiler settings. This does not
+add a profiling-only collective. Leave this option disabled for
+independent replicas without a shared forward cadence. All participating ranks
+must use the same profiler configuration.
+
+With data-parallel size one, or with a model runner that does not support
+synchronized iterations (such as the standalone CPU model runner), profiling
+keeps its rank-local behavior and logs that this option has no effect.
+
+Coordinated model-runner dummy forwards that occur while the session is armed
+count as execution boundaries, not only dummy work caused by an idle DP rank.
+Forwards that explicitly skip DP coordination do not advance this clock. Startup
+warmup and graph-capture runs occur before the session is armed and do not
+count. The first captured synchronized boundary may not include the outer
+worker-level iteration annotation because readiness is agreed inside the model
+runner; subsequent captured boundaries retain their annotations. This does not
+affect the iteration window itself.
+
+For a DP-aligned bounded stop, use `max_iterations`. An explicit stop remains
+immediate on the worker receiving it; peers observe the de-armed state before
+their next shared forward. As a result, trailing non-forward activity can differ
+between ranks after an explicit stop.
+
 #### Analysis
 
 You can view these profiles either as summaries in the CLI, using `nsys stats [profile-file]`, or in the GUI by installing Nsight [locally following the directions here](https://developer.nvidia.com/nsight-systems/get-started).
